# GitHub Copilot Instructions

`AGENTS.md` at the root of the repository is the source of truth for the shared instructions.
Read `AGENTS.md`, and follow it, before you work in this repository.

Some Copilot features read this file but not `AGENTS.md`, for example Copilot Chat on GitHub.com, in Visual Studio, and in JetBrains IDEs.
For those features, always apply these minimum rules:

- Keep secrets, personal information, customer information, and internal URLs out of all files.
- Use relative paths, and state each assumption about the operating system or the environment.
- Get approval before you change repository rule documents, Skill bodies, or other operational guidance.

If you cannot read `AGENTS.md`, stop, and report that the shared instructions are not available.
Change files, run commands, and make external changes only after you can read `AGENTS.md`.

Keep the shared instructions in `AGENTS.md`.
Add guidance to this file only when a Copilot feature needs client-specific loading or behavior.
